responsibility: Provides the core target configuration header for the FR-V port. It defines driver, assembler, linker, startup, ABI, preprocessor, register, calling-convention, scheduling, if-conversion, builtin, and miscellaneous target macros that parameterize GCC for FR-V processors, including default feature masks for CPU variants, predefined macros such as __FRV_VLIW__ and CPU identifiers, and the backend-wide constants and hook macros used by frv.cc and frv.md.
same_name_distinction: Configuration header for the FR-V port: unlike frv.cc it does not implement hooks, unlike frv.md it does not describe RTL insns, and unlike frv.opt it does not declare command-line options; instead it supplies the target macros, constants, builtin IDs, and hook interfaces that parameterize the other FR-V files.
